candidates.classification: Independent 95e revisit of the earlier authored correction identity question, separate from revision narrowing and not a new unique historical defect.
candidates.trace: The selected generated-testimony pipeline derives its proposition from draft.proposition_id; process_report carries that ID into the claim and safe receipt. persist_generated_testimony chooses a prior belief by draft.corrects_proposition_id and passes its ID to staging. If a prior owner/case belief for A exists and a processed draft has proposition B but correction target A, where A and B remain distinct after namespacing, the receiver rejects the prior belief because its proposition does not match receipt B. This follows the selected guards; an actually accepted developer definition, reachable player action, database transaction and outcome were not demonstrated.
candidates.producer_and_limits: The ordinary generated branch sets its secondary correction and its proposition to the same description ID when a correction is present. The selected developer definition has distinct fields; reference validation checks that both point to declared proposition IDs and namespace mapping separately remaps them. The selected quest validation uses a nonempty correction to require witness referral reachability but does not itself establish an equality rule. These observations do not prove a complete distinct-ID developer case passes every other structural, replay, location, referral and gameplay guard. The lead-correction path and belief-revision path are distinct related obligations, not automatically aliases.
candidates.connected_repair: After the audit gate, decide whether a belief correction revises the same proposition or may supersede another proposition. Make authored admission, namespacing, staged receipt, prior-belief selection and native receiver agree, and keep lead correction semantics explicit. No legacy dual path is required.
candidates.later_acceptance: After separately authorized implementation and validation, cover same-proposition correction, any intentionally supported cross-proposition correction, missing or other-observer targets, generated and developer definitions, and receipt/replay and lead visibility behavior.
candidates.discovery: partial; authored correction policy, full developer validity, native reachability, rollback and aliases remain open
